purpose: Record the first completed source-specific extraction rows for Human Infra domain modeling, converting selected method anchors from queue items into audited endpoint, population, uncertainty and transfer-boundary fields without opening calibrated prediction.

scope.selectionRule: Complete the four method anchors that constrain survival curves, hazards, intervention estimands and prediction-model reporting before expanding into biological mechanism anchors.
currentLimitations: Only 25 of the 81 queued domain-source tasks are complete.
Rows are method-anchor extractions, not full external literature fresh reviews.
Completed rows keep calibrated prediction, individual recommendation and intervention ranking blocked.

sourceAnchorDecisions.transferBoundary: Transfer only as survival-curve and event-time vocabulary. It does not validate domain parameters, prove intervention benefit, or authorize personal prognosis.
Transfer only as hazard vocabulary and covariate-risk positioning. It does not prove causality, personalize risk, or rank interventions by itself.
Transfer only as causal-design discipline for future intervention evaluation. It does not establish that any domain intervention works.
Transfer only as a prediction-reporting and validation checklist. It does not authorize clinical prediction, individual advice or automated action.
